scope_outcomes.basis: Anchored passages in both works support an unordered comparison between efficiency-based technical neutrality and means‑oriented instrumental rationality. The comparison identifies a shared qualification while preserving differences in object and scope.
limitations: No dates or uptake evidence were supplied, so no ordered development can be claimed.

Together they support the finding’s claim of a shared restriction to means‑oriented evaluation and denial of its adequacy for social ends.
